verdict.rationale: DeepInfra offers GPU clusters with SSH access for training/fine-tuning your own model, and separately supports deploying 'your own fine-tuned weights' on dedicated private instances for serving — so the two pieces of the story (train + serve) both exist on the platform, but there is no evidence of an integrated managed fine-tuning job/API (like uploading a dataset and calling a fine-tune endpoint) that automatically produces a servable model; it's a manual DIY-train-then-manually-deploy workflow. Missing for 10: a managed fine-tuning API/pipeline, evidence of automatic hand-off from training job to serving endpoint, and independent confirmation this workflow works end-to-end.
